brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: a base with removable bins for small parts
requirements.evidence: pieces at 0,0,0 full, 1,0,0 full, 0,1,0 half-s provide base; bins hex-bin-full-div2 at 0,0,0 (2 compartments) and hex-bin-half-s-full-div2 at 0,1,0 are drop-in removable trays

finish.summary: Portable 3-piece base provides bins, drawer and handle. Two compartmentalized removable bins serve small-parts storage, a drawer provides enclosed storage at 0,1,0, and a top-mounted handle on cell 1,0,0 provides carry function. Mesh clear.

lines.label: Bin, south half, full depth, 2 compartments
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Build features removable small-parts bins, a drawer, and a carry handle on a multi-cell base.

**Layout:** 3-piece base (two full hexes at 0,0,0 and 1,0,0 plus half-s at 0,1,0). Top cover on 1,0,0 hosts the handle; remaining open tops receive drop-in bins.

Portability via centralized handle keeps footprint compact (approx. 2.5 hexes wide).

Passed configurator checks: meshClash clear, no errors.
